text:
Ammonia, NH3, dissolves in water to form a dilute solution of ammonium hydroxide, NH4OH.
The reaction is reversible and exists as an equilibrium mixture.
+(aq)  +  OH–(aq)
NH3(g)  +  H2O(l)
NH4
Which statement about the mixture is correct?
A
All of the ammonia and water molecules have turned into ions.
B
The ammonia and water molecules have stopped changing into ions.
C
The concentrations of the ammonia molecules and ammonium ions are always equal.
D
The rate of the formation of ammonia molecules is equal to the rate of formation of the
ammonium ions.
